title: Fit a spring-loaded four-hook sun clip to folded glasses
instruction: Mount the tinted sun clip on the glasses. Cover both clear lenses and catch the upper and lower hooks around each outside rim. Let go.
context: A wearer fits this removable clip to add sun lenses to their glasses. A missed hook can leave a corner unsecured even when the lenses look level.
setup: Place a rectangular acetate frame (120 mm across, 38 mm from top to bottom) on a flat 145 by 172 mm microfiber mat, 8 mm thick. Fold the temples and lay the clear lenses facing up. Place the spring clip 150 mm in front, on a separate 25 mm high pad of folded cloth that supports its bridge and leaves both outer ends exposed. Both tinted lenses face up, the four return hooks face down, and the bridge is relaxed. The clip is centred 7 mm left of the frame. Tape the cloths to the worktop. The glasses and clip are loose.
scoring: Check the final second using the overhead view and a low close-up of each outer rim. The folded glasses must rest on their mat. Both hands stay clear, and the clip stays clear of both cloths. For each side, verify that the tinted panel covers its clear lens, the two hook shanks pass outside the rim, and BOTH pale return tips overlap the far face of that rim. One fully secured side earns 0.5. Two fully secured sides earn 1. A clip perched on top, or one supported by a hand or cloth, earns zero. Earlier attempts may be retried.
reset_notes: Lift the clip off the frame, let the spring bridge relax and return the two loose pieces to their cloths with their lenses facing up.
fidelity: The rectangular clear polycarbonate lenses and tinted clip have distinct optical surfaces. Each bent metal hook and both folded temples have collision geometry. A passive spring acts between the two tinted sections. The taped cloth pads are represented by rigid blocks with friction. The optical power, temple folding and minor flexibility of the frame and hooks are omitted.
